rows.grounds: compound gūḍha plus sadbhāva in accusative singular
abstract noun sarvajña plus tva in accusative singular
verb pra-jan third singular middle present

items.question: What arises for one who knows the hidden true nature?
premises: Knowing hidden true nature leads to all-knowingness.
The verse states arising of all-knowingness.
items.inference: All-knowingness arises from knowing the hidden true nature.
uncertainties: Gender of taṃ is contextually ambiguous.
gūḍhasadbhāvaṃ may function as an accusative object or modifier.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
